# Al Waheed Group of Companies

> Al Waheed Group of Companies is a Karachi, Pakistan real estate group founded in 2016 by Abdul Waheed Meo. It works in property development, construction, sales and marketing, and investment. It develops the United Palm Greens gated community, sponsors Khair un Nisa, was an authorized dealer for Al Ghafoor Builders & Developers (2022 to 2023) and has been an authorized dealer for Falaknaz Group since 2023.

- [About](https://alwaheedgroup.com/about/): company story, milestones, vision, mission and values

- [Projects](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/): United Palm Greens, Khair un Nisa and upcoming projects
- [United Palm Greens](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/united-palm-greens/): Gated Community in Main 400 White Road, Sector 6, Surjani Town, Karachi. Plots: 120, 400 and 2,000 Sq. Yds. Payment: 36 monthly and 6 half yearly installments.
- [Khairunnisa Heights](https://alwaheedgroup.com/projects/khairunnisa-heights/): Residential Apartments in Karachi. Plots: undefined. Payment: 24 monthly and 4 half yearly installments.
- [Payment Schedule (PDF)](https://alwaheedgroup.com/downloads/united-palm-greens-payment-schedule-120-sq-yds.pdf): United Palm Greens, 120 Sq. Yds residential plot: booking, installments, extra charges and terms
